    Class
    Description
    UDFFillContext
    Everything a fill rule may read about one security, collected before the evaluation, so that UDFFillTemplate.evaluate(UDFFillContext, grafioschtrader.entities.UDFMetadataSecurity) performs no I/O.
    UDFFillDecision
    The decision table of the write rule "manual values always win".
    UDFFillDecision.RowAction
    Change of the row in udf_data_fill.
    UDFFillDecision.ValueAction
    Change of the value in udf_data.
    UDFFillOutcome
    What a fill source answered for one security, computed outside any transaction and handed to UDFFillWriter.write(grafioschtrader.entities.UDFMetadataSecurity, int, UDFFillOutcome).
    UDFFillScopeService
    Determines what a fill run works on — the tenant scope of a field — and computes the outcome of a fill source for one security.
    UDFFillTaskQueue
    Enqueues fill runs of user-defined security fields.
    UDFFillTemplate
    Parser and evaluator of the rule of the fill source TEMPLATE.
    UDFFillTemplate.FallThroughReason
    Why a line did not produce a value.
    UDFFillTemplate.LineOutcome
    Why one line fell through.
    UDFFillTemplate.PlaceholderName
    The attributes of a security a placeholder can read.
    UDFFillTemplate.TemplateResult
    The result of evaluating a rule for one security.
    UDFFillTemplateException.Reason
    The kinds of parse errors.
    UDFFillWriter
    The only code path that writes an automatic value or a fill row.
    UDFFillWriter.ProposalRecord
    What a value proposal run records for one cell.
    UDFFillWriteResult
